create_world_asset: create a WorldAsset protobuf message with objects, regions, and mesh paths for a robotics simulation scene
create_object: create an Object protobuf message with an id, label, bounding box, and mesh path
create_region: create a Region protobuf message with an id, label, and either a bounding box or polygon
create_generalbox3f: create a GeneralBox3f protobuf message with a center vector, dimensions, and quaternion orientation
create_vvector3f: create a VVector3f protobuf message with x, y, and z float coordinates for 3D positioning
